projectPreview.title: Orbit Analytics Platform
projectPreview.shortDesc: Multi-tenant dashboards for operations teams with real-time KPIs.
projectPreview.longDesc:
A full redesign and rebuild of the core reporting experience. Role-based views, scheduled exports, and drill-downs that stay fast at scale.

Stack: React, Node, Postgres. Engagements included UX research, UI system, and observability hardening.

projectPreview.title: PulsePing
projectPreview.shortDesc: Uptime alerts and status pages for lean teams—our in-house micro-SaaS.
projectPreview.longDesc:
Born from client requests for simpler incident comms. PulsePing combines monitoring hooks, Slack integration, and branded status pages.

Subscription billing and team seats included.

projectPreview.title: Harbor Retail Omnichannel
projectPreview.shortDesc: Unified commerce experience across web, in-store kiosks, and staff tools.
projectPreview.longDesc: Discovery through launch: inventory sync, cart persistence, and BOPIS flows. Close collaboration with legal and compliance on regional variants.

projectPreview.title: SnippetVault
projectPreview.shortDesc: Team snippet manager with shared variables and environment-scoped secrets (demo product).
projectPreview.longDesc:
SnippetVault showcases secure sharing patterns we reuse in client work—scoped tokens, audit trails, and editor integrations.

Not production for external signups; reference architecture only.

projectPreview.title: Aperture Health Portal
projectPreview.shortDesc: Patient-facing portal with appointment scheduling and encrypted messaging.
projectPreview.longDesc: Accessibility-first UI, WCAG 2.2 AA target, and hardened session handling. Worked alongside clinical stakeholders for safe consent flows.

services.title: Strategy & discovery
services.shortDesc: Workshops, roadmaps, and prioritization grounded in user evidence.
services.longDesc: We align stakeholders, clarify outcomes, and define a pragmatic plan. Deliverables include UX audits, technical feasibility notes, and a milestone roadmap your team can execute against.

services.title: Product design
services.shortDesc: Interfaces that feel effortless—accessible, responsive, and on-brand.
services.longDesc: From wireframes to high-fidelity UI, we craft flows that reduce friction. We document components and states so engineering can move quickly without guesswork.

services.title: Web development
services.shortDesc: Fast, secure frontends with clean architecture and observability.
services.longDesc: We ship production-ready builds with performance budgets, sensible security defaults, and maintainable code structure—ready for your next phase of growth.

projects.title: Orbit Analytics Platform
projects.shortDesc: Multi-tenant dashboards for operations teams with real-time KPIs.
projects.longDesc:
A full redesign and rebuild of the core reporting experience. Role-based views, scheduled exports, and drill-downs that stay fast at scale.

Stack: React, Node, Postgres. Engagements included UX research, UI system, and observability hardening.

projects.title: PulsePing
projects.shortDesc: Uptime alerts and status pages for lean teams—our in-house micro-SaaS.
projects.longDesc:
Born from client requests for simpler incident comms. PulsePing combines monitoring hooks, Slack integration, and branded status pages.

Subscription billing and team seats included.

projects.title: Harbor Retail Omnichannel
projects.shortDesc: Unified commerce experience across web, in-store kiosks, and staff tools.
projects.longDesc: Discovery through launch: inventory sync, cart persistence, and BOPIS flows. Close collaboration with legal and compliance on regional variants.

projects.title: SnippetVault
projects.shortDesc: Team snippet manager with shared variables and environment-scoped secrets (demo product).
projects.longDesc:
SnippetVault showcases secure sharing patterns we reuse in client work—scoped tokens, audit trails, and editor integrations.

Not production for external signups; reference architecture only.

projects.title: Aperture Health Portal
projects.shortDesc: Patient-facing portal with appointment scheduling and encrypted messaging.
projects.longDesc: Accessibility-first UI, WCAG 2.2 AA target, and hardened session handling. Worked alongside clinical stakeholders for safe consent flows.

blogPosts.title: Nexus Studio expands remote delivery footprint
blogPosts.excerpt: How we scale synchronous collaboration without slowing delivery cadence.
blogPosts.body:
Teams often ask how we keep velocity high across time zones. Our answer is simple: fewer meetings, clearer artifacts, and a shared definition of done.

In this post we share the rituals that keep stakeholders aligned without thrash—the same patterns we use on client engagements weekly.
blogPosts.metaTitle: Remote delivery at scale | Nexus Studio
blogPosts.metaDescription: Practical rituals for distributed teams shipping product and web experiences.

blogPosts.title: Introducing better performance budgets for marketing sites
blogPosts.excerpt: A practical checklist to keep Lighthouse green as content grows.
blogPosts.body:
Performance is a feature—not a phase. We codify budgets for LCP, CLS, and JS payload early so content editors can publish confidently.

Walk through the thresholds we recommend for brochure sites vs. app shells, and how we monitor regressions in CI.
blogPosts.metaDescription: Lighthouse-friendly thresholds for brochure sites and content-heavy pages.

blogPosts.title: Why we invest in internal micro-SaaS
blogPosts.excerpt: Small tools sharpen our craft and create reference implementations.
blogPosts.body:
Micro-SaaS products are not a distraction—they are living labs. Shipping subscription billing, auth, and onboarding for our own tools keeps patterns fresh.

Clients benefit from battle-tested snippets rather than experiments invented mid-project.
blogPosts.metaDescription: How internal products improve delivery quality for client work.

blogPosts.title: Design systems office hours—notes from May
blogPosts.excerpt: Themes, tokens, and governance questions from recent sessions.
blogPosts.body:
We hosted open office hours for teams adopting design systems. Common questions: token naming, when to fork a component, and how to version breaking visual changes.

Here are consolidated answers plus links to further reading.
blogPosts.metaDescription: Token naming, component forks, and versioning in design systems.

blogPosts.title: Shipping accessible forms without the friction
blogPosts.excerpt: Patterns for validation, errors, and focus management that users feel as effortless.
blogPosts.body:
Accessible forms are not only about WCAG checklists—they reduce support load and improve completion rates. We document error copy, live regions, and keyboard flows in one place.

Reuse this pattern library in your next lead capture or onboarding flow.
blogPosts.metaDescription: Validation, focus management, and error patterns for inclusive forms.
